data.long_meaning: One who is the lord of victory and success, often used as a title for gods and kings. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shuresh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shuresh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
